Question: Some people not have an electricity cnnection at home and they cook food on heater without pay electric bill.they are roza aftar to it food.i want to know that is it permissiable in islam? Answer ID: 2652 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 752/736=L) Using electricity in this way is disallowed.
